summary: Abruzzo Airport, also commonly known as Pescara Airport, is the main international gateway for Italy's Abruzzo region on the Adriatic coast. Situated between Pescara and Chieti, it connects central-eastern Italy to several European destinations and supports both leisure tourism and regional business travel. Originally developed from a military airfield, the airport serves as a convenient entry point for visitors exploring the region's mountains, beaches, and historic villages.
